name: Nature's Lament
source:
"I don't really know where to start either. Maybe with how I'm feeling?" 

A mini character study, Nature's Lament provides insight into Amelia Mallas - also known as OneWithNature.

[From [url=https://heartmoorstudios.itch.io/natures-lament]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
“我也不知道从哪里开始。也许是我的感觉？” 

《自然的哀歌》是一项迷你人物研究，深入了解阿米莉亚·马拉斯（也称为OneWithNature）。

[来自[url=https://heartmoorstudios.itch.io/natures-lament]Itch.io[/url]]
